decisions: Input fills its caller layout with min-inline-size0 and semantic 32px minimum height. The native 320px sample width is not an intrinsic component token and remains in source evidence. Source font14/20px,10px inline/4px block padding, border/radius and distinct placeholder/focus/disabled/error styling are retained. Label/help/field are explicit caller parts. Rounded shape is caller className, not an invented Input prop.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
